content.text: Section 22 is the only audit right binding us, and it meets the preferred position on every material term.

input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit/verification right binding us (no inspection right appears elsewhere; § 23 has no operative text). It meets the preferred position on every material term: frequency limited to once in any twelve-month period, thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality (§ 22.1); Vendor bears costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent, and Vendor and its auditor are barred from direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential information (§ 22.2). Section 22.3 additionally protects findings as our Confidential Information. No redline needed.
